thread.title: 5 Biggest Price Target Changes For Wednesday | Benzinga

author: Lisa Levin
title: 5 Biggest Price Target Changes For Wednesday | Benzinga

organizations.name: cracker barrel old country store, inc.

text: JP Morgan raised the price target for Spirit Airlines Incorporated (NYSE: SAVE ) from $59 to $82. Spirit Airlines shares closed at $58.76 on Tuesday. Wedbush boosted salesforce.com, inc. (NYSE: CRM ) price target from $160 to $166. salesforce.com shares closed at $127.54 on Tuesday. UBS cut the price target on TransMontaigne Partners L.P. (NYSE: TLP ) from $55 to $41. TransMontaigne Partners shares closed at $41.09 on Tuesday. Telsey Advisory Group raised the price target on Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBRL ) from $175 to $190. Cracker Barrel shares closed at $183.29 on Tuesday. Wedbush cut the price target for Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) from $310 to $275. Apple shares closed at $174.24 on Tuesday.
